091        public void init(MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats, SkillSpecAPI skill) {
092                indent = BaseIntelPlugin.BULLET;
093                tc = Misc.getTextColor();
094                hc = Misc.getHighlightColor();
095                dhc = Misc.setAlpha(hc, 155);
096                alpha = 255;
097                float level = stats.getSkillLevel(skill.getId());
098                if (level <= 0) {
099                        tc = Misc.getGrayColor();
100                        hc = dhc;
101                        alpha = 155;
102                }
103                dtc = Misc.getGrayColor();
104        }

168                }

295        protected float computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(MutableShipStatsAPI stats,
296                        String key, float maxBonus, ThresholdBonusType type) {
297                FleetDataAPI data = getFleetData(stats);
298                MutableCharacterStatsAPI cStats = getCommanderStats(stats);
299                return computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(data, cStats, key, maxBonus, type);
300        }
301        protected float computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(FleetDataAPI data, MutableCharacterStatsAPI cStats,
302                        String key, float maxBonus, ThresholdBonusType type) {
303//              if (key.equals("pc_peak")) {
304//                      System.out.println("efwfwefwe");
305//              }
306                if (data == null) return maxBonus;
307                if (cStats.getFleet() == null) return maxBonus;
308
309                Float bonus = (Float) data.getCacheClearedOnSync().get(key);
310                if (bonus != null) return bonus;
311
312                float currValue = 0f;
313                float threshold = 1f;
314                
315                if (type == ThresholdBonusType.FIGHTER_BAYS) {
316                        currValue = getNumFighterBays(data);
317                        threshold = FIGHTER_BAYS_THRESHOLD;
318                } else if (type == ThresholdBonusType.OP) {
319                        currValue = getTotalCombatOP(data, cStats);
320                        threshold = OP_THRESHOLD;
321                } else if (type == ThresholdBonusType.OP_LOW) {
322                        currValue = getTotalCombatOP(data, cStats);
323                        threshold = OP_LOW_THRESHOLD;
324                } else if (type == ThresholdBonusType.OP_ALL_LOW) {
325                        currValue = getTotalOP(data, cStats);
326                        threshold = OP_ALL_LOW_THRESHOLD;
327                } else if (type == ThresholdBonusType.OP_ALL) {
328                        currValue = getTotalOP(data, cStats);
329                        threshold = OP_ALL_THRESHOLD;
330                } else if (type == ThresholdBonusType.MILITARIZED_OP) {
331                        currValue = getMilitarizedOP(data, cStats);
332                        threshold = MILITARIZED_OP_THRESHOLD;
333                } else if (type == ThresholdBonusType.PHASE_OP) {
334                        currValue = getPhaseOP(data, cStats);
335                        threshold = PHASE_OP_THRESHOLD;
336                } else if (type == ThresholdBonusType.AUTOMATED_POINTS) {
337                        currValue = getAutomatedPoints(data, cStats);
338                        threshold = AUTOMATED_POINTS_THRESHOLD;
339                }
340                
341                bonus = getThresholdBasedRoundedBonus(maxBonus, currValue, threshold);
342
343                data.getCacheClearedOnSync().put(key, bonus);
344                return bonus;
345        }

492        public interface TooltipCreatorSkillEffectPlugin {
493                void addDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam);
494                List<FleetMemberPointContrib> getContributors();
495        }
496        public TooltipCreator getTooltipCreator(final TooltipCreatorSkillEffectPlugin plugin) {
497                return new BaseTooltipCreator() {
498                        public float getTooltipWidth(Object tooltipParam) {
499                                return TOOLTIP_WIDTH;
500                        }
501                        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
502                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
503                                float pad = 3f;
504                                float opad = 10f;
505                                
506                                plugin.addDescription(tooltip, expanded, tooltipParam);
507                                
508                                tooltip.addPara("Certain skills will have reduced effects if this value exceeds a "
509                                                + "skill-specific threshold; see the specific skill for details. Mothballed "
510                                                + "ships are not counted towards the total.", opad);
511                                
512                                tooltip.addPara("Skills using this value:", opad);
513                                tooltip.setBulletedListMode(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT);
514                                List<SkillLevelAPI> skills = (List<SkillLevelAPI>) tooltipParam;
515                                Set<SkillLevelAPI> seen = new HashSet<MutableCharacterStatsAPI.SkillLevelAPI>();
516                                
517                                float initPad = opad;
518                                //initPad = pad;
519                                for (SkillLevelAPI skill : skills) {
520                                        if (seen.contains(skill)) continue;
521                                        seen.add(skill);
522                                        String label = skill.getSkill().getName() + " (" + skill.getSkill().getGoverningAptitudeName() + ")";
523                                        label = skill.getSkill().getGoverningAptitudeName() + " - " + skill.getSkill().getName();
524                                        tooltip.addPara(label, 
525                                                        skill.getSkill().getGoverningAptitudeColor(), initPad);
526                                        initPad = pad;
527                                }
528                                tooltip.setBulletedListMode(null);
529                                
530                                List<FleetMemberPointContrib> members = plugin.getContributors();
531                                Collections.sort(members, new Comparator<FleetMemberPointContrib>() {
532                                        public int compare(FleetMemberPointContrib o1, FleetMemberPointContrib o2) {
533                                                return o2.points - o1.points;
534                                        }
535                                });
536                                
537                                tooltip.addPara("Ships contributing to this value:", opad);
538                                initPad = opad;
539                                //initPad = pad;
540                                if (members.isEmpty()) {
541                                        tooltip.setBulletedListMode(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT);
542                                        tooltip.addPara("None", initPad);
543                                        tooltip.setBulletedListMode(null);
544                                }
545                                float gridWidth = 450f;
546                                //tooltip.beginGrid(gridWidth, 1);
547                                tooltip.beginGridFlipped(gridWidth, 1, 40f, opad);
548                                int i = 0;
549                                int max = 20;
550                                if (members.size() == max + 1) {
551                                        max = members.size();
552                                }
553                                for (FleetMemberPointContrib member : members) {
554//                                      String label = tooltip.shortenString(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT + getValueLabelForMember(member.member),
555//                                                                                                      gridWidth);
556                                        String label = tooltip.shortenString(getValueLabelForMember(member.member),
557                                                        gridWidth - 60f);
558                                        tooltip.addToGrid(0, i++, label, "+" + member.points);
559                                        if (i >= max) break;
560                                }
561                                tooltip.addGrid(opad);
562                                if (members.size() > max) {
563                                        tooltip.addPara("And %s other ships with a smaller contribution.", opad, 
564                                                        Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + (members.size() - max));
565                                }
566                                
567                        }
568                };
569        }

571        public static String getValueLabelForMember(FleetMemberAPI member) {
572                String str = "";
573                if (!member.isFighterWing()) {
574                        str += member.getShipName() + ", ";
575                        str += member.getHullSpec().getHullNameWithDashClass();
576                } else {
577                        str += member.getVariant().getFullDesignationWithHullName();
578                }
579                if (member.isMothballed()) {
580                        str += " (mothballed)";
581                }
582                return str;
583        }

586        public float getThresholdBasedBonus(float maxBonus, float value, float threshold) {
587                float bonus = maxBonus * threshold / Math.max(value, threshold);
588                return bonus;
589        }
590        public float getThresholdBasedRoundedBonus(float maxBonus, float value, float threshold) {
591                float bonus = maxBonus * threshold / Math.max(value, threshold);
592                if (bonus > 0 && bonus < 1) bonus = 1;
593                if (maxBonus > 1f) {
594                        if (bonus < maxBonus) {
595                                bonus = Math.min(bonus, maxBonus - 1f);
596                        }
597                        bonus = (float) Math.round(bonus);
598                }
599                return bonus;
600        }

622                                ((stats.getVariant().hasHullMod(HullMods.CIVGRADE) &&

670                }
671                return Math.round(op);

751        public static float getNumFighterBays(FleetDataAPI data) {
752                if (data ==  null) return FIGHTER_BAYS_THRESHOLD;
753                float bays = 0;
754                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : data.getMembersListCopy()) {
755                        if (curr.isMothballed()) continue;
756                        bays += getNumBaysIncludingModules(curr);
757                        //bays += curr.getNumFlightDecks();
758                }
759                return bays;
760        }
761        
762        public static float getNumBaysIncludingModules(FleetMemberAPI member) {
763                float bays = 0f;
764                bays += member.getNumFlightDecks();
765                if (member.getVariant().getModuleSlots() != null) {
766                        for (String slotId : member.getVariant().getModuleSlots()) {
767                                if (slotId == null) continue;
768                                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant().getModuleVariant(slotId);
769                                if (variant == null) continue;
770                                bays += variant.getHullSpec().getFighterBays();
771                        }
772                }
773                return bays;
774        }

776        public static List<FleetMemberPointContrib> getNumFighterBaysDetail(FleetDataAPI data) {
777                List<FleetMemberPointContrib> result = new ArrayList<BaseSkillEffectDescription.FleetMemberPointContrib>();
778                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : data.getMembersListCopy()) {
779                        if (curr.isMothballed()) continue;
780                        //int pts = curr.getNumFlightDecks();
781                        int pts = (int)Math.round(getNumBaysIncludingModules(curr));
782                        if (pts <= 0) continue;
783                        result.add(new FleetMemberPointContrib(curr, pts));
784                }
785                return result;
786        }

788        public static float getAutomatedPoints(FleetDataAPI data, MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats) {
789                float points = 0;
790                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : data.getMembersListCopy()) {
791                        if (curr.isMothballed()) continue;
792                        if (!Misc.isAutomated(curr)) continue;
793                        if (Automated.isAutomatedNoPenalty(curr)) continue;
794                        float mult = 1f;
795                        //if (curr.getCaptain().isAICore()) {
796                                points += curr.getCaptain().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(AICoreOfficerPlugin.AUTOMATED_POINTS_VALUE);
797                                mult = curr.getCaptain().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(AICoreOfficerPlugin.AUTOMATED_POINTS_MULT);
798                                if (mult == 0) mult = 1;
799                        //}
800                        points += Math.round(getPoints(curr, stats) * mult);
801                }
802                return Math.round(points);
803        }

805        public static List<FleetMemberPointContrib> getAutomatedPointsDetail(FleetDataAPI data, MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats) {
806                List<FleetMemberPointContrib> result = new ArrayList<BaseSkillEffectDescription.FleetMemberPointContrib>();
807                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : data.getMembersListCopy()) {
808                        if (curr.isMothballed()) continue;
809                        if (!Misc.isAutomated(curr)) continue;
810                        if (Automated.isAutomatedNoPenalty(curr)) continue;
811                        float mult = 1f;
812                        int pts = (int) Math.round(getPoints(curr, stats));
813                        //if (curr.getCaptain().isAICore()) {
814                                pts += (int) Math.round(curr.getCaptain().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(AICoreOfficerPlugin.AUTOMATED_POINTS_VALUE));
815                                mult = curr.getCaptain().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(AICoreOfficerPlugin.AUTOMATED_POINTS_MULT);
816                                if (mult == 0) mult = 1;
817                        //}
818                        result.add(new FleetMemberPointContrib(curr, Math.round(pts * mult)));
819                }
820                return result;
821        }

823        public static boolean isInCampaign() {
824                return Global.getCurrentState() == GameState.CAMPAIGN && 
825                           Global.getSector() != null && 
826                           Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet() != null;
827        }

829        public static MutableCharacterStatsAPI getCommanderStats(MutableShipStatsAPI stats) {
830                if (stats == null) {
831                        if (isInCampaign()) {
832                                return Global.getSector().getPlayerStats();
833                        }
834                        return null;
835                }
836                
837                FleetMemberAPI member = stats.getFleetMember();
838                if (member == null) return null;
839                PersonAPI commander = member.getFleetCommanderForStats();
840                if (commander == null) {
841                        boolean orig = false;
842                        if (member.getFleetData() != null) {
843                                orig = member.getFleetData().isForceNoSync();
844                                member.getFleetData().setForceNoSync(true);
845                        }
846                        commander = member.getFleetCommander();
847                        if (member.getFleetData() != null) {
848                                member.getFleetData().setForceNoSync(orig);
849                        }
850                }
851                if (commander != null) {
852                        return commander.getStats();
853                }
854                return null;
855        }
856        
857        public static FleetDataAPI getFleetData(MutableShipStatsAPI stats) {
858                if (stats == null) {
859                        if (isInCampaign()) {
860                                return Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData();
861                        }
862                        return null;
863                }
864                FleetMemberAPI member = stats.getFleetMember();
865                if (member == null) return null;
866                FleetDataAPI data = member.getFleetDataForStats();
867                if (data == null) data = member.getFleetData();
868                return data;
869        }
